_comment: The setup wizard's own vocabulary, in the four languages the rest of the
app speaks. It lives here rather than in electron/strings.js because the
renderer loads it directly and must not require() into the main process.
Every failure `installer.js` can return has a code, and every code has an
entry under `errors`. A code with no entry falls back to the English
sentence the installer produced -- which is better than nothing, but is the
thing this file exists to avoid: a German user meeting `ENOTFOUND` twenty

en.cpuDetail: About {{size}} GB. Works on any computer, but indexing is slow.

en.longStep: This step takes the longest — usually {{minutes}} minutes or so.

reasons.macosCpuOnly: Orienta runs on this Mac's processor and needs about {{size}} GB. Graphics-card acceleration needs an NVIDIA card, which Apple computers do not have.

reasons.freeSpaceUnknown: The free space on this drive could not be read, so Orienta cannot tell whether it will fit. This happens when the user folder is on a network drive. Set ORIENTA_HOME to a folder on this computer and try again.

warnings.cudaUnverified: Orienta konnte die Grafikkarte nicht prüfen, weil PyTorch zu lange zum Starten gebraucht hat. Die Installation selbst ist fertig — starten Sie Orienta, und die Karte wird genutzt, sofern sie funktioniert.

reasons.macosCpuOnly: Orienta läuft auf dem Prozessor dieses Macs und braucht etwa {{size}} GB. Beschleunigung über die Grafikkarte setzt eine NVIDIA-Karte voraus, die es in Apple-Rechnern nicht gibt.
